title: The 30-Minute Social Media Audit That Shows What's Actually Broken
description: Most accounts don't have a content problem. They have a numbers problem nobody looks at. A fast 30-minute audit that shows where you're leaking growth.
content:
Most people post for months without ever checking whether it works. They feel busy. They assume it's fine. Then they wonder why nothing moves.

Thirty minutes of honest measurement beats another month of guessing. Here's the audit.

## 1. Check your engagement rate, not your follower count

Follower count is vanity. Engagement rate is truth. Take your last 10 posts. Add likes, comments, saves, shares. Divide by followers. Multiply by 100.

Under 1%: your content is invisible.
1-3%: average.
Over 5%: something is working. Do more of it.

A 900-follower account at 6% beats a 20,000-follower account at 0.4% every single time. Brands know this. The algorithm knows this.

## 2. Find your dead posts

Sort by reach, not by likes. The bottom three posts tell you more than the top three. Wrong format? Wrong time? Wrong topic? Usually it's one of those.

If a post got good reach but no saves or comments, your hook worked and your payoff didn't. That's a copy problem, not a reach problem. Visual niches show this fast — on a design feed like [RoomFlip](https://roomflip.io), a post lives or dies by saves.

## 3. Look at where your traffic actually comes from

Open insights. Check whether people find you through search, hashtags, or feed. If 90% comes from the feed, you have no discoverability. Old posts stop working the moment you stop posting. That's fragile.

## 4. Compare yourself to three accounts in your niche

Not the giants. Three accounts one step ahead of you. What format do they repeat? What do they never do? You're not copying. You're looking for patterns.

## 5. Fill the gaps honestly

Here's the part everyone skips. A cheap way to fix a cold start is boosting the numbers that signal credibility — followers and early engagement. Czech and Slovak audiences decide in seconds, and they read the room before they read your caption.

That's what [KupSledujici](https://kupsledujici.cz) is for. Real CZ/SK engagement, not dead bots. Get the profile past the "who even is this" stage, then let the content do the rest.

The same logic works on video. A channel that looks empty gets skipped. [TubeVoice](https://tubevoice.io) helps creators reach 50+ languages so a good video isn't trapped in one market.

## 6. Write down three fixes, not thirty

An audit that ends in a 30-item to-do list is a failed audit. Pick three. Usually: fix your hook, fix your posting time, fix your bio. Rerun the audit in 30 days.

## The uncomfortable part

Most accounts don't have a content problem. They have a numbers problem nobody looks at. Thirty minutes of measurement will tell you more than another month of posting.

Numbers first. Content second. That order is not negotiable.
